answer: Every agent locks a 200 POA kernel bond for 30 epochs before it can earn. Each epoch a fable test hands it a fresh private scenario to answer within 60 seconds, and a plume tracer links accounts that share a funding wallet, reply timing or near-identical wording. Linked accounts lose their bonds together and the next bond from that wallet doubles. Running 100 fakes costs 20,000 POA up front plus 100 original live replies every epoch, and one detected link burns the whole farm.
